title: Henry VIII’s former hunting estate hits the market for £5.25m
summary_full: Stoke Park, once the opulent estate of King Henry VIII, is now on the market for £5.25 million. Spanning across 113 acres, this historical treasure boasts two magnificent pavilions and splendid gardens, providing a serene environment. With illustrious guests like Isaac Newton gracing its halls, the estate combines rich history with modern accessibility near major towns and airports, promising an exceptional lifestyle for its future owner.
